frozen_observations_from_persisted_gate4.interpretation: SW0 retained some rank discrimination, especially visible in top1 accuracy, but its probability assignment was materially worse than uniform on exact ordered-top3 NLL and pooled winner calibration. The result therefore rejects SW0 as a promotable probability model under the frozen test.

postmortem_hypotheses_not_claimed_as_fac: H1: the synthetic selection objective was insufficiently aligned with real probability calibration; synthetic KL robustness did not guarantee calibrated real ordered-top3 probabilities.
H2: the fixed score coefficient / PL sharpness may be overconfident for the real score scale, because top1 discrimination can coexist with poor NLL/Brier.
H3: a single score-only conditional-order map may omit race-regime structure needed for second/third-place probability quality even when winner ranking contains signal.
H4: segment heterogeneity is material enough that a globally fixed probability sharpness can be unstable, but no segment-specific real-data fitting is authorized or proposed from this result.
anti_overfit_rules: Do not tune any coefficient, temperature, feature weight, threshold, calibration map, or model selection criterion on Gate #487 protected outcomes.
Do not rerun Gate #487 or rescore its protected result with a changed model.
Use Gate #487 only as a falsification/postmortem signal to define broad failure modes, not as an optimization dataset.
Any replacement model must be selected and frozen using synthetic-only evidence or separately authorized non-outcome evidence before any new protected evaluation.
DEV2000 C and ECON_HOLDOUT1000 remain sealed/excluded.

next_owner_free_synthetic_research.objective: Test whether probability sharpness / conditional-order structure can be made robust in synthetic worlds without using protected real outcomes.

candidate_families.description: Score-only Plackett-Luce with a small preregistered finite set of synthetic-selected global temperatures; no real-outcome fitting.
Low-freedom blend of normalized score level and within-race score rank, selected only on synthetic worlds to reduce sensitivity to score-scale drift.
A bounded lower-sharpness ordered-top3 probability map designed to preserve ranking while reducing catastrophic NLL from overconfidence; synthetic selection only.

required_synthetic_gates: evaluate across W0-W4 and field sizes 5-9 on multiple untouched synthetic seeds
include probability calibration / NLL / Brier gates, not KL-to-N2 alone
reject candidates that improve average metrics by creating severe worst-cell calibration failures
freeze exactly one candidate or conclude NO_SYNTHETICALLY_ELIGIBLE_REPLACEMENT

next_protected_boundary: After a replacement is synthetically selected and frozen, any new real-result predictive evaluation requires a NEW exact Owner Gate and a fresh preregistration. No such Gate is created by this artifact.
